## Checklist

- [ ] Backend tests pass (`cd backend && python -m unittest discover -s tests`)
- [ ] Frontend tests pass (`cd frontend && npm test`)
- [ ] No existing test was left failing (if one changed, the description says why)
- [ ] Regression test added, if this fixes a bug
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry added, if a user would notice this
- [ ] Screenshots attached, if this changes the UI
